negative_findings.description: No Slovenia-specific country-manager appointment announcement was found for NCR Atleos or Diebold Nixdorf, in either English or Slovenian search. Results returned only global-level leadership and M&A coverage.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched 'NCR Atleos Diebold Nixdorf Slovenia country manager appointed banking'; all hits were global trade press (American Banker, ATM Marketplace) or the NCR Atleos board page. No SI-country announcement surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The global ATM OEMs appear to run Slovenia through regional/distributor structures rather than a locally announced country manager, so leadership signal for them must come from LinkedIn, the SI business register (branch/subsidiary representatives) and partner/distributor announcements — not from vendor newsrooms.

negative_findings.description: No Printec Slovenia local careers page or SI-specific job listing was located this run; only registry/company-profile records for PRINTEC S.I. d.o.o. surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian-language query 'Printec Slovenija zaposlitev prosta delovna mesta' returned generic SI job portals and a CompanyWall entity profile (Vodovodna cesta 100, Ljubljana, ~26 employees, sln_info@printecgroup.com), not a Printec SI careers page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For the anchor vendor of this cell, hiring visibility likely depends on the group-level careers site, LinkedIn and the ESS statutory vacancy channel rather than a local careers page — collection design must not assume a local page exists.

negative_findings.description: Marand and 'Result' could not be confirmed this run as currently active Slovenian banking-IT suppliers with public hiring channels; searches naming them returned no Marand/Result pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query 'Comtrade Marand Halcom zaposlitev razvijalec bancne resitve Ljubljana' and 'Bankart Better Marand ...' returned Comtrade, Halcom and Bankart material only; no Marand or Result result appeared.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seeded actor map may contain stale or health-sector-skewed names (Marand's better-known line is health IT / the Better spin-off). The actor map needs verification against AJPES before collection resources are spent on them.

negative_findings.description: There is no established Slovenian-language term for 'delivery centre' in the nearshore-outsourcing sense; searches had to use the English phrase.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian equivalents ('razvojni center', 'razvojno sredisce') are generic R&D terms and did not isolate nearshore delivery-centre announcements; the English-in-Slovenian usage 'delivery center' is what vendors actually publish.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design for delivery-centre expansion must mix English-in-local usage with 'razvojni center' + city names, or the signal will be missed entirely in sl-language monitoring.

negative_findings.description: The two highest-yield channels for leadership moves in this cell — LinkedIn and Finance.si — are both restricted (login wall + ToS; paywall).
negative_findings.result_summary: LinkedIn company pages appear in results but require authentication and prohibit scraping; Finance.si operates a subscription paywall on its IKT coverage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget and process must account for licensed/manual collection on these two, otherwise the 'leadership moves' topic will be systematically under-covered for private suppliers.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash-handling and cash-in-transit / cash-cycle suppliers to SI banks (e.g. cash automation, CIT operators, safe/recycler vendors) were not reached in this run; only ATM/self-service OEMs and software integrators were covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sl-language pass on 'obdelava gotovine', 'prevoz gotovine', 'varnostno prevozniska sluzba', 'blagajniski avtomat', 'recikler bankovcev' and cross-reference AJPES SKD 80.10 companies serving banks.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-side procurement/tender evidence for private banks was not pursued (out of cell), but supplier-side signals would be much easier to interpret if paired with e-JN / bank RFP notices where the bank is state-linked (SID banka, SDH-owned entities).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Coordinate with the procurement cell to cross-map supplier hiring spikes against any public e-JN notices naming banking IT lots.

coverage_gaps.description: Several candidate URLs are inferred rather than fetched (payten.si, printecgroup.com careers path, mojedelo.com), and no URL in this slice was liveness-verified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness/verification pass over every URL; for 403/timeouts treat as bot-defended-but-live and retry with a browser-grade fetch before demoting.

coverage_gaps.description: Regional-language coverage (hr/sr/bs) was only incidental, yet ASEE/Payten, Comtrade and ASEE Solutions publish group careers and appointment news in Croatian and Serbian, often before any SI-language version.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add hr/sr query variants ('zaposlenje', 'oglasi za posao', 'imenovan direktor', 'bankarska rjesenja') targeting see.asseco.com, adorio.hr, infostud.com and dzobs.com for SI-relevant roles.

coverage_gaps.description: No systematic channel was identified for detecting delivery-centre openings or office expansions by foreign vendors in Slovenia (lease/real-estate, municipal or investment-agency announcements).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout SPIRIT Slovenija / Invest Slovenia investment announcements and Ljubljana office-market reports as an indirect early-warning channel for vendor footprint expansion.

brief: Slovenia's banking-supply side is almost entirely private and small, so hiring and leadership signal is fragmented across four layers: vendor careers pages that genuinely publish (Bankart, Halcom, Kontron SI, Endava Ljubljana), national job aggregators and the statutory ESS/PDM-1 vacancy channel that catch the vendors who do not, the AJPES business register which is the only near-authoritative record of country-manager and representative changes at private d.o.o. suppliers, and local IT trade press (Racunalniske novice, Finance.si Top IKT) for appointment announcements. The global ATM OEMs (NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf) show no Slovenia-specific leadership publication at all, so for them LinkedIn plus registry-level entity monitoring is the only realistic route — and both LinkedIn and Finance.si are access-restricted, which is the single largest structural constraint on this cell. Slovenian-language querying was essential and productive: 'zaposlitev', 'prosta delovna mesta', 'zastopnik/novi direktor', 'bancne resitve' and 'karticno poslovanje' surfaced entities and pages that English queries never returned. The main uncovered actor group is cash-handling/cash-cycle suppliers, and no URL here has been liveness-verified.
